title: SocialEvent
description: Normalized event published by the collectors to kol.raw.<platform>. Message key = kol_id (keeps all events of one KOL in the same partition, in order). PROPOSAL - agree on it with the collector (Module 2) and stream consumer (Module 3) owners.

event_id.description: UUID generated by the collector, used for de-duplication

content_id.description: Native id on the platform (Bluesky URI, YouTube videoId/commentId, Reddit t1_/t3_ id)

parent_id.description: Post/video this comment or reply belongs to

kol_id.description: <platform>:<native account id> of the KOL being evaluated

metrics.description: Interaction counters at collection time (absent fields = unknown)

created_at.description: When the content was created on the platform (UTC)
